chunks: So do not allow them to starve and they should not be ruined in your presence.

key_terms.اللَّهُ اللَّهَ: Repetition of Allah's name used for emphasis and exhortation
key_terms.بِحَضْرَتِكُمْ: In your presence / under your care
key_terms.تُغِبُّوا: You cause to go hungry / starve

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic instruction regarding the care of orphans?
ai.summary: In this pivotal passage from his final testament to Hasan and Husayn, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elevates the care of orphans from a mere social duty to a spiritual imperative, urging guardians to protect their dignity and sustenance. This instruction reflects the Shia emphasis on *adab* (etiquette) in treatment, warning against the subtle neglect of 'letting them go hungry' or being 'lost' in one's presence, which implies both physical and emotional abandonment. It serves as a practical guide for the community's leadership, linking the preservation of the Prophet's lineage to the broader ethical stewardship of the vulnerable.
